label: Paraxially matched spherical control / distance-corrected v1
evidence: Frozen Monofocal Refraction Audit selected scalar; formal quadratic-sag wrapper; no new optimization.
nominal_power_note: 20 D is the baseline reference label. Added surface correction changes effective power; no new commercial nominal power is asserted.

distance_correction.surface_note: Quadratic addition retains the baseline higher-order sag; corrected spherical control is not an exact two-sphere lens.
